competences.description: Attacks the enemy to decrease its Defense for 2 turns with a 50% chance. The damage increases according to your Attack Speed.

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.

competences.description: Increases your Attack Speed for 2 turns, then attacks the target once and random enemies 5 times. The faster your Attack Speed, the greater the damage becomes. When attacking, stuns targets for 1 turn with a 30% chance.

effets.description: The target's Attack Speed will be increased by 30%.
The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.

competences.description: Gains immunity against inability effects. Additionally, increases the damage dealt according to your Critical Rate. Increases your Attack Bar by 10% whenever your attack lands as a Critical Hit. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
effets.note: Whenever your attack lands as a Critical Hit

competences.description: Attacks the enemy with an attack that always has an attribute advantage and ignores effects that resist death. If you have attacked the enemy target with HP below 30%, deals additional damage by 30% of the target's MAX HP (10% if it's a boss). [Divine Slash Ultimate] can be used twice per battle, and increases your Attack Bar by 50% after using the skill.

effets.description: The skill always has an elemental advantage regardless of monster elements.
Ignores all effects that resist death

effets.note: If the target has below 30% HP (10% if a boss)

effets.description: Skill has a limited number of usages per battle.
